description: A pope in a white cassock with a red and gold mantle stands on a stone balcony, right hand raised in blessing. A cardinal in red stands to the left holding a crucifix-topped staff. Below, a dense crowd of men in top hats and women in bonnets and shawls waves white handkerchiefs in a sunlit square. Behind them are classical buildings, a tall obelisk and statues. No visible text, frame or border; the painting runs edge to edge.
